notes.notes:
1. Architecture changes on the code level

4. Gamepad support improved, partially

notes.title: Update 0.0.2.1
notes.notes:
More gameplay and content improvements
Gamepad support improved
Added the way to quit minigames
Added the Skip functionality for the intro/outro and the credits
Added the additional translations for posters
And a lot of small bugs were fixed!

Important Note
If you have problems with the cursor not reaching the menu buttons, press Alt-Tab twice. We are working to fix this issue.

notes.title: bugfixes
notes.notes:
Performance improved.
Fixed level streaming bugs.
Fixed doors blocking.
Added Intro movie clip.
Added more interactive objects highlights for the story quests.
Adjusted the dialogues volume level in the 3rd chapter.
And a lot of small bugs were fixed!
